topic: Millions of Eggs Recalled Due to Salmonella Fears
headline: MILLIONS OF EGGS RECALLED ACROSS 17 STATES DUE TO SALMONELLA OUTBREAK, 26 HOSPITALIZED
summary: Nearly 100 people in 17 states have been sickened in a salmonella outbreak tied to recalled eggs, with 26 people hospitalized and no deaths reported. The outbreak is linked to shell eggs recalled by Midwest Poultry Services, an Indiana-based company. The illnesses started between November 21 and June 30, according to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration. This is one of several recent salmonella outbreaks, including ones linked to cucumbers, peanut butter, and chicken products.
